name: phd-cannot-evaluate-survives-a-passed-deadline
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: a blank rules-sheet cell is not a missed deadline. This student passed all three core areas and the research qualifier and has the nine ND regular credits — the ONLY thing unresolved is that `category_courses_required` is missing from the Parameters tab, so §4.4.2 cannot be evaluated. Both deadline overrides used to bulldoze that into "unmet — Overdue, talk to the DGS" (and, on the time-limit row, into an alarming "the 8-year limit passed" forfeiture message for a student who had in fact finished). CLAUDE.md: a missing parameter renders "cannot evaluate", never a default. Since 2026-11-03 (DGS, the round-5 question “emails-2”: “Read Overdue whenever another requirement is unmet or in progress”) the time-limit row reads Overdue here — this student is far from finished (9 of 60 credits), so the blank is not all that stands between the record and complete; `phd-finished-past-the-limit-one-blank` is the student who has finished, whose row still cannot be judged.

detailIncludes: cannot be evaluated until the rules sheet is complete
may apply to the Graduate School for dissertation completion status
